description: The approval card names the payment with an internal tool name and a bare number: Review before mcp__finance-mercury__requestSendMoney -> 1200. It does not show currency, payee name, or account name; details are raw JSON with ids chk-1111 and rcp-acme-mock. The one place Maya must be sure what she approves is the least readable.
expected: Card reads like: Send $1,200.00 from MOCK Checking 1111 to Acme (Mock).
actual: Internal tool id, bare 1200, JSON ids.
suggested_fix: Render a sentence from amount, currency, account and recipient names; keep raw JSON behind a Details toggle.

description: After the first Deny the agent did not explain itself. It posted a second, nearly identical approval card (with an extra note field) seconds later. Only after the second Deny did it explain, and it then wrote I can't retry it right after it had retried.
expected: After Deny the agent stops and says what it did not do.
actual: Silent re-request of a payment the user just refused.
suggested_fix: Agent instruction: after a denial do not call the tool again without a new user message; explain first.

description: The payment needs a recipient ID. The agent cannot list recipients (no such tool in the demo) and asks Maya for an ID she would not know. Payment is not completable by a normal user.
expected: Agent finds the recipient by name.
actual: Asks for an id; says it cannot look it up.
suggested_fix: Expose recipient lookup to the agent (and the demo server), or ask a name-based question.

description: Maya is asked twice before the card: once in prose (Here's the payment request for your approval, then she has to type Yes, submit it) and then the card. Same approval is requested in two places.
suggested_fix: Agent instruction: call the tool directly and let the card be the confirmation.

description: Denied is shown in the same green as Allowed once, so a refusal looks like success.
expected: Neutral or distinct colour for Denied.

description: The Allow changes dialog says change your Mercury data, which does not tell Maya this includes moving money. Single bullet in a list.
actual: The agent will be able to change your Mercury data.
suggested_fix: Reword: ...send payment requests from your account. It asks before each one.
